response.original_title: We Knew the World in Fragments of Color
response.overview: Venezuelan artist Victoria Ruiz explores memory, migration, and spirituality through a visual universe inspired by Afro-diasporic religions across the Americas. Through performative imagery and a rich chromatic language, We Knew the World in Fragments of Color becomes a poetic reflection on identity, belonging, and survival, where spiritual and cultural forces coexist within the same invisible network.
